subject: Commit sanity check: orphaned deals + close-date validation
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit sanity check: orphaned deals + close-date validation

Team —

Quick ask before I lock the forecast for the month-close: we still have a non-trivial tail of opportunities that look like "stale" (no activity in >60 days) but are sitting in commit or later stages in SFDC. Finance flagged them during the preliminary roll-up and would like a fast sanity check so we can be conservative for revenue recognition.

Action requested by EOD Tuesday (2027-06-22):
- Owners: confirm each opportunity in the attached export is either (A) still active with an updated close plan and next-step, or (B) reclassify to Omitted / Upside / On-hold with a short reason.
- If you need to move a close date forward/back, add a one-line rationale in column "owner_note" on the sheet.
- If you disagree with recommended stage, mark it and tag me + Finance.

I attached a CSV extract (SFDC-export-20270619.csv) and a small template to speed the updates. I also created a shared sheet with filters: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-commit-checksheet

Please prioritize deals > $50k and any with "commit" flags. I will reconcile changes and send a final adjusted forecast to Finance on Wed morning.

Thanks —
Monica
Monica Patel
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit sanity check: orphaned deals + close-date validation

On Sun, Jun 20, 2027 at 8:12 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Quick ask before I lock the forecast for the month-close...

Thanks Monica — I'm on it. I scanned the export and flagged three deals I own that need either a close-date push or a stage change:
- CL-4319 (healthcare pilot) — no activity since April; recommend move to Upside, add note.
- CL-4392 (procurement delays) — move close date to 2027-09-15, added a short rationale in the sheet.
- CL-4440 (legal review) — will follow up with Kristen (Clarity) today and update by EOD Tue.

I'll go through the rest and mark up the template. If anyone else wants me to triage high-dollar orphaned opps, ping me.

Ben
Senior Account Executive

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:47:35 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit sanity check: orphaned deals + close-date validation

Thanks for kicking this off, Monica.

I did a quick sweep for my book: I locked two small deals into Omitted (CL-4210, CL-4247) because the buyer has deprioritized for this quarter — I added notes. For mid-size deals with outstanding blockers, I left them in Upside and added a short next-step + owner_note.

A suggestion for next month: can we add a column that indicates last_sales_activity_date so we can triage automatically? Marcus — can you add that to the export filter so Revenue Ops doesn't have to hand-clean as much?

Laura
Account Director

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kristen Lee <kristen@clarityhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit sanity check: orphaned deals + close-date validation

Appreciate the quick updates — this is exactly what we needed. Summary / next steps: 
- Ben: noted CL-4392 push and CL-4440 follow-up — please update final status by 6pm PT today.
- Laura: thanks for locking the two small deals to Omitted; I see your notes.
- Marcus: can you add last_sales_activity_date to the export for next month? If you can, please confirm by EOD Wed.

Kristen / Clarity — looping you on the thread so you're aware that Ben will reach out about CL-4440 (legal review) and that we've temporarily removed a couple of smaller opportunities from commit as we reconcile internal timelines. No action required from you unless Ben reaches out for an update.

I'll reconcile the sheet and push the adjusted commit to Finance first thing tomorrow morning. Thanks team for moving fast.

Attachments referenced: SFDC-export-20270619.csv, commit-validation-template.xlsx

Monica
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
